top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a complete, mature chain from physiology (Holst on the incretin effect and GLP-1 action in humans, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor pharmacology, Mojsov on the active GLP-1(7-36) form) to patient benefit confirmed in independent randomised outcome trials. The three-name allocation fits the cap and the citation can stay on discovery rather than specific drugs. The open Mojsov versus Habener-group priority question is real but not disqualifying, and no award is a worse outcome than this prize.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my 2009 co-authored paper with Thomas Perlmann involves no candidate in the slate
